tools.name: woocommerce_list_products
tools.description: List products in the store with price, sale price, stock and status. Filter by search text, status, type, SKU, category id or stock status. WooCommerce API: GET /products.

tools.name: woocommerce_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with prices, stock, categories, images and variations ids. WooCommerce API: GET /products/{id}.

tools.name: woocommerce_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with status, totals, billing and line items. Filter by status, date range, customer id or search text. Newest first by default. WooCommerce API: GET /orders.

tools.name: woocommerce_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id, with its billing and shipping address, line items, totals and status. WooCommerce API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: woocommerce_list_order_notes
tools.description: List the internal and customer notes on one order. WooCommerce API: GET /orders/{id}/notes.

tools.name: woocommerce_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (registered shoppers) with their e-mail, name and role. WooCommerce API: GET /customers.

tools.name: woocommerce_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with contact details and addresses. WooCommerce API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: woocommerce_list_coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons with type, amount, usage and expiry. WooCommerce API: GET /coupons.

tools.name: woocommerce_sales_report
tools.description: Sales totals for a period (gross sales, net sales, orders, items, refunds, shipping, discounts) with per-interval totals. WooCommerce API: GET /reports/sales.

tools.name: woocommerce_top_sellers
tools.description: The best-selling products for a period, by quantity sold. WooCommerce API: GET /reports/top_sellers.

tools.name: woocommerce_order_totals
tools.description: Order counts per status for the whole store (for example processing, completed, on-hold). WooCommerce API: GET /reports/orders/totals.

tools.name: woocommerce_update_product_price
tools.description: Change a product's regular price and, when given, its sale price. Pass sale_price as an empty string to remove the sale. This changes the live price the shoppers see. WooCommerce API: PUT /products/{id}.

tools.name: woocommerce_update_product_stock
tools.description: Turn on stock management for a product and set its stock quantity. This changes what the shoppers can buy. WooCommerce API: PUT /products/{id}.

tools.name: woocommerce_update_order_status
tools.description: Set an order's status (pending, processing, on-hold, completed, cancelled or failed). WooCommerce may e-mail the customer the status e-mail for that status. Refunds are not part of this tool. WooCommerce API: PUT /orders/{id}.

tools.name: woocommerce_add_order_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to an order. The note is not sent to the customer. WooCommerce API: POST /orders/{id}/notes.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "woocommerce_list_coupons" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
